descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S06 「后端对 AI 和邮件服务商的外呼全是 HTTPS」 Backend outbound calls to AI and email providers are all HTTPS

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 All traffic is encrypted in transit. This includes the live-dictation audio stream and the backend's calls to the AI and email providers (Bedrock, Vertex, OpenAI, SES).（UAT OAT-02；TFA-92568 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given convex/ at the UAT build; the aiProvider row the UAT deployment uses (provider, visionProvider); the Convex deployment's Integrations page (log streams, webhooks); and the scheme of these env values on the deployment, read by Tim (unset = SDK default https; …

When List every outbound endpoint the backend calls: Bedrock (AWS SDK, bedrock-runtime), Vertex (Google GenAI SDK), OpenAI chat completions and vision (api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions, selectable as provider 'openai' and visionProvider 'openai' in convex/ai/providers/index.ts), OpenAI transcription (api.openai.com/v1/au …

Then Every endpoint is https://. Each env override above is unset or starts with https://. A path that is unused on the deployment is recorded as unused (AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER=ses, so the relay is unused).

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-02 Expected 'All traffic encrypted in transit' (scope per Q2). One http:// endpoint or env override in use = Fail, quoted with the file or variable. Which AI actually ran each step is S03 (3.9), not this review.

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S06 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：code-review。

UAT item: OAT-02 Encryption Verification · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-02/S06

Backend outbound calls to AI and email providers are all HTTPS

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status partial → 待人看（部分：能查的这半通过，另一半要别的 lane / 人 / 文件 → 待人看）。

Detail:

The code passes. Every outbound call in apps/web/convex uses https, set in one of three ways:
- **Hard-coded https:** OpenAI transcription posts by fetch() to "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions" (transcribe.ts:12/156). SES requests are signed by the code itself and built as `https://${host}` with host = email.<region>.amazonaws.com; AWS_SES_REGION or AWS_REGION only picks the region, never the scheme (ses.ts:39/89/101/120).
- **SDK default (https):** Bedrock uses a BedrockRuntimeClient with no endpoint set (bedrock.ts:85). Vertex uses a GoogleGenAI client with vertexai=true and no base URL (vertex.ts:150). OpenAI chat and vision use `new OpenAI({ apiKey })` with no baseURL (openai.ts:92). Live-session key minting calls client.realtime.clientSecrets.create on an OpenAI client with no baseURL (transcribe.ts:71-74). Each of these can still be redirected by an env var the SDK reads itself: OPENAI_BASE_URL, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL / AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME, and the GenAI SDK's base-URL vars.
- **Built from an env var:** the Specode relay does fetch(SPECODE_EMAIL_RELAY_URL) (email.ts:18/25). It only runs when AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER is not "ses" and SPECODE_EMAIL_MODE is "platform"; when AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER=ses it is never reached.

The scheme-relevant http:// literal in the code is the dev fallback `process.env.SITE_URL ?? "http://localhost:5173"` (auth.ts:105). The backend never fetches that value. It is used as the crossDomain siteUrl and a trusted origin, so it is not an outbound endpoint under the question's rule. It would only apply if SITE_URL were unset, which is part of Tim's env check. The only other http strings are origin-matching patterns, not endpoints. Provider choice is 'openai' | 'bedrock' and visionProvider 'openai' | 'vertex' (providers/index.ts:23/26); which one the aiProvider row picks is a data question. No recorded gaps or open questions are involved.

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • The SITE_URL fallback 'http://localhost:5173' (auth.ts:105) is not an outbound call, but it would become the crossDomain siteUrl and a trusted origin if SITE_URL were unset on UAT. Tim's env check should confirm that SITE_URL is set to https.
  • The question's pass/fail rule fails on 'any http:// endpoint in code'. The only http:// literal is the SITE_URL dev fallback (auth.ts:105). It is a redirect/trusted-origin value, not an outbound call, so it was not counted as a failure. Tim should confirm SITE_URL is set to an https value on the UAT deployment.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • env overrides on the deployment (CONFIG (Tim reads each scheme))
  • unused paths on the deployment (CONFIG (Tim))
  • Scheme of SITE_URL on the UAT deployment (unset would mean the http://localhost fallback)
  • SPECODE_EMAIL_RELAY_URL scheme, and whether the relay is unused (AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER=ses, SPECODE_EMAIL_MODE)
  • AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER value
  • AWS_SES_REGION / AWS_REGION (only picks the region; the https scheme is fixed in code)
  • OPENAI_BASE_URL (read by the OpenAI SDK for chat, vision and live-session minting; the transcription fetch ignores it)
  • AWS_ENDPOINT_URL and AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME (read by the AWS SDK)
  • GOOGLE_VERTEX_BASE_URL / GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL or any other base-URL override the Google GenAI SDK reads
  • BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS schemes
  • CONVEX_SITE_URL (Better Auth baseURL)
  • Which provider and visionProvider the deployment's aiProvider row selects
  • Convex log-stream and webhook destinations (Integrations page)
  • Scheme of these env values on the deployment: SITE_URL, SPECODE_EMAIL_RELAY_URL, OPENAI_BASE_URL (read by the openai SDK), AWS_ENDPOINT_URL, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME, BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS, and any Google GenAI base-URL override (e.g. GOOGLE_VERTEX_BASE_URL / GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL).
  • AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER and SPECODE_EMAIL_MODE values (whether the relay is unused), and AWS_SES_REGION/AWS_REGION.
  • Which provider and visionProvider the deployment's aiProvider row selects.
  • Convex log-stream and webhook destinations (Integrations page).

审查结论（verdict）：pass

证据：附了 2 个。
